Repository service (pipeline service-delivery)

Stage refinement (concurrency 3, retries 2, childrenStartAt next, legacy)
  actions:
    1. legacy.enterCheck (check generic) [act]
       wait timeout unlimited, poll 1m; onFail decided by the task
    2. legacy.produce (agent darya) [act]
       wait timeout unlimited, poll 1m; onFail decided by the task
    3. legacy.exitCheck (check refinement-exit; feedback cycles 2) [act]
       wait timeout unlimited, poll 1m; onFail decided by the task
  exit-gate:
    1. legacy.succeeded (producer outcome is success) [check]
       wait timeout unlimited, poll 1m; onFail stop blocked
